Because the pearl stake is held until the delta settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the karst audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 42% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
